name: Hume Expression APIs
desc: Scores vocal and facial expression from voice or video
desc_zh: 从语音或视频里测出表情与情绪得分的 API
solves: A transcript loses the sigh and the hesitation. These APIs return structured expression scores alongside the words.
solves_zh: 转写稿会把叹气、犹豫这些信息全丢掉。这组 API 在文字之外给出结构化的表情分数。
best_for: You need to know which callers sound frustrated, not just what they said.
best_for_zh: 不光要知道客户说了什么，还想知道哪几通听起来在生气。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://hume.ai/blog (Hume's blog, 'Introducing Expression APIs' entry)）。 A measurement API, not the ledger's 'Hume AI' voice product (2024-06-19). Hume's own product navigation lists it as one of five products (Audio Decision API, Expression APIs, Human Feedback API, User Testing API, Speech Data); the other three have no date-carrying first-party page I could fetch, so they are not filed. 首次公开日期来源：https://hume.ai/blog/introducing-expression-apis-give-your-ai-more-of-what-people-mean
